Pristine production regressions: six initial CPU/GPU failures; eleven with boundary cases; separate normal/gap instance matrix failures.

No backdrop dependencies did not imply a single plain batch. Root reuse now requires the actual old batch and current plain chunk structure; normal adjacent-run selection handles scoped moves and boundaries.

Flat command synchronization now retires old Scene commands even when their IDs remain live; empty Group-to-Scene replacement inserts a command without full recompilation. Proven missing-location/container and kind retry substitutes are removed.
Gap reconciliation now records replaced instances in removed_nodes before releasing chunks/resources, matching normal journal semantics. Metadata publication moved into its own module.

Initial fixes passed 11 of 12 regressions; a remaining GPU failure and an additional CPU regression proved generation-only revision identity retained old pixels. A cached-filter reinsertion separately reproduced the same flaw.

NodeRevision carries both instance and generation in every command, frame and surface producer; the obsolete generation-only type and unused scalar conversion are deleted. Surface cache identity test now covers changed instance with equal generation.
Focused command tests (14), damage (21), surface (23) and retained (201) pass. Permanent coverage includes 18 normal/gap Group/Scene/Layer transitions and five GPU tests with 10 fresh comparisons.

The extra changed-layer location guard was removed after proving that every replaced Layer instance is retired and cannot qualify as a removed plain leaf. Actual shape, batch adjacency, allocation reuse and pending-neighbor decisions remain necessary semantics.
